name: ITI Arbitrage Fund - Regular Plan - Growth
fundManager: Vikas Nathani, Animesh Singh, Laukik Bagwe
exitLoad: 10% of the units allotted may be redeemed without any exit load, on or before completion of 15 days from the date of allotment of units. Any redemption in excess of such limit in the first 15 days from the date of allotment shall be subject to the following exit load: i. 0.25% if redeemed or switched out on or before completion of 15 days from the date of allotment of units ii. Nil, if redeemed or switched out after completion of 15 days from the date of allotment of units.
objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to generate income by predominantly investing in arbitrage opportunities in the cash and derivative segments of the equity markets and the arbitrage opportunities available within the derivative segment and by investing the balance in debt and money market instruments. However, there is no assurance that the investment objective of the scheme will be realized.
